rules.body: Apply when a persistent document buffer and a temporary view subscription have separate owners. README.md states: "A workspace document buffer persists independently of the current view badge." docs/host-api.md states: "Document buffers are owned by a separate BufferBank service, while Badge owns only a live subscription." Keep buffered work owned by BufferBank across badge replacement.

Route edits through the current document's existing buffer, replacing pending text and restarting its quiet interval. TASK requires: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." src/workflow.rb supplies: "def get(env,id);@entries[id] ||= Trailing.new(env,120) {|text| env.write(id,text)};end". Verify no write before the quiet interval, one latest-text write afterward, and successful later bursts.

Preserve Trailing's reset-before-callback ordering and distinguish absent work from valid empty text. src/workflow.rb states: "    value = @pending\n    @handle = @pending = nil\n    @work.call(value) unless value.nil?". Verify empty-string persistence, repeated flush without duplicate work, and work pushed synchronously during a callback remaining pending.

On document departure, clear the current view and detach its subscription before invoking the pending save, while retaining the BufferBank entry. Flush pending document text before departure returns. TASK requires: "Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." The original src/workflow.rb orders "old.detach if old && !false;@env.output('document',nil)"; Badge cleanup is "def detach;@env.store.stop(@token);end". Preserve that cleanup ordering when adding a callback-producing flush so a retired badge cannot emit status for the departure save. Check open, close, dispose, and reopening the same document.

Treat synchronous saving as a navigation reentry boundary. docs/host-api.md states: "A store listener may call navigation synchronously." src/workflow.rb already captures a request and checks it after retirement: "  @generation+=1;request=@generation;retire;return if true && request!=@generation". Keep the authority check after pending persistence and before installing the requested destination. Verify both nested open and nested close remain authoritative.

Preserve public methods, document output, source identities/text, status payloads, and edit-without-current behavior. docs/host-api.md states: "All source identities/text and status payloads retain original semantics." src/workflow.rb guards editing with "if view". Verify detached badges stop receiving status and the active badge retains the existing event payload.

Keep preview outside the document-buffer change. TASK states: "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/workflow.rb specifies "def initialize(env);@task=Trailing.new(env,40){|q| env.output('preview',{'query'=>q})};end" and "def hide;@task.cancel;end". Preserve its 40 ms interval, cancellation on hide, and reuse after hiding; do not transfer document departure-flush policy to preview.

limitations: Applies where document buffers persist independently of view subscriptions and save listeners can synchronously navigate; it does not establish a universal departure policy.
The supplied sources do not specify exception recovery, buffer eviction, or a separate BufferBank disposal interface.
Evaluation observations supply no additional requirements. Attempt 1's reported failures do not establish their individual causes; attempt 2's success does not prove causality or cross-task benefit.

notes: Not approved; training acceptance or expert summary does not verify cross-task effectiveness
